source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Providing specialized care for critically ill clients with neurological conditions, including frequent neurological assessment and management of complex neuro-specific devices","B":"Mostly administrative scheduling tasks for the unit, with fairly little direct clinical involvement in the day-to-day care of critically ill clients","C":"Fairly little involvement expected in communicating with or providing education to the families of critically ill neurological clients on the unit","D":"A role fairly similar to that of a general ICU staff nurse position, without much specialized neurological focus actually built into the daily work"}}
source_row.rationale: A neuro ICU nurse's role typically involves providing specialized care for critically ill clients with neurological conditions, including frequent neurological assessment and management of complex neuro-specific devices and monitoring (such as ICP monitors), along with family communication and education given the often complex and uncertain nature of severe neurological injury.
